tuning.tuning_summary_narrative: Tuned Support Vector Machine using 5-fold Stratified GridSearchCV across 25 parameter candidates. Achieved best CV ROC-AUC of 0.9957. Held-out test ROC-AUC reached 0.9974 (baseline: 0.9947). Paired bootstrap analysis across 3,000 resamples provides rigorous confidence bounds on observed metric differences.

top_features.clinical_significance: Most heterogeneous texture region. Reflects coarse chromatin clump distribution.
Number of concave contour points. Strong indicator of invasive margin irregularity.
Largest nuclear radius observed across fine needle aspirate (FNA). Catches extreme atypical cells.
Severity of concave portions of the contour. Nuclear membrane indentations are hallmarks of malignancy.
Largest perimeter observed. Highlights the most dysplastic cell in the sample.
Largest nuclear area observed. Strongest single morphological marker of severe dysplasia.
Deepest concave membrane depressions. Indicates profound nuclear clefting.
Maximum number of membrane cleft indentations. High clinical sensitivity for carcinoma.
Morphological characteristic 'worst symmetry' quantified from FNA biopsy digital images.
Standard deviation of gray-scale values. High variation reflects chromatin texture heterogeneity.
